Khushi se zyada anand jeevan ka antim lakshya hai, kyunki anand dard ke beech bhi ho sakta hai.
Khushi phoolna hai.
Khushi kuch arthpoorn karne ki koshish ka byproduct hai.
Khushi andar se aati hai, bahar se nahi.
Khushi santulan hai.
Khushi chamkili hai.
Uncharted maps aur halka dil matlab true freedom.
Azadi prakriti hai.
Azaadi chunne ka haq hai, niti sahi chunav hai.
Khushi gyan ka tohfa hai.
Duniya mein sirf ek hi joy hai – shuru karna.
Aazadi apna rasta khud chunne ka haq hai.
Aazadi jung ke hathiyar se nahi, shanti ke hathiyaron se milti hai.
Adventure joy ka ultimate form hai.
Joy apne hathon se river water ka taste lena hai.
Khushi jadoo hai.
Khushi santushti hai.
Khushi dil ki hansi hai.
Sachhi aazadi ke liye balidan chahiye hota hai.
Joy zindagi ki antim jeet hai.
Aazadi manmaani shakti se mukti hai.
Khushi pyar ke sath jeene ka adhyatmik anubhav hai.
Khushi tab milti hai jab aap doosron se tulna karna band kar dete hain.
Sachhi khushi hum par zyada nirbhar karti hai.
Khushi zindagi ki dhadkan hai.
Khushi ka saar hi khushi hai.
Freedom nowhere ka one-way ticket hai.
